score_assessment: Of ~26 constraints, only 3 are clean HITs and all 3 are generic logistics, not feature-specific. The rest are 11 MISS and ~12 PARTIAL. matchScore 27 is low-to-middling and is propped up entirely by non-discriminating access clues.

test_1_distinct_fit.reasoning: The three HITs are: surface-not-buried, trail-accessible, within-3mi-road. Every one of these is true of essentially EVERY spot in the Rocky Face catalog (the whole park is <3mi from road, on trails, no digging). They are JCB-baseline filters, not signatures of THIS spot. Meanwhile the constraints that COULD distinguish a spot — elevated-overlook (MISS), panoramic-view (MISS), saddle-gap-notch (MISS), rounded-stone-shape (MISS), crystalline-quartz (MISS), small-confirming-mark (MISS), left-orientation (MISS, this junction actually turns RIGHT) — all fail here. The near-water constraint is PARTIAL-against, because it is a CROSSING (trail crosses the water), which conflicts with a 'stay on the dry bank / water never crossed' reading. No specific, hard-to-generalize constraint singles out this streambank; the same generic hits would fit any low creek point on any mountain.

public_land.note: Rocky Face Mountain Recreational Area, Alexander County public park.

within_3mi_road.note: ~0.5 mi from parking; well under 3 miles (HIT confirmed in match).

not_buried_no_digging.note: Cache would rest against streambank rocks/roots at/above ground; surface-not-buried is a HIT.

not_dangerous_no_water_crossing.note: DECISIVE FAILURE. The spot's defining feature is a creek CROSSING where the trail crosses the water; the match notes it is 'often wet and slippery.' JCB explicitly ruled out water crossings and dangerous footing. A hide whose landmark is the act of crossing a creek sits squarely against that rule. The match itself flags this conflict (near-water-not-crossed = PARTIAL with the note that the crossing nature 'works against it').

findable_in_light_snow.note: A low streambank in a wooded draw, keyed to a watercourse and small rock/root niches, is seasonally variable (water level, leaf litter, snow cover) and hard to relocate precisely under light snow.

carry_25lb_load.note: 0.5 mi carry is easy, but the final approach is a wet/slippery creek crossing — awkward and mildly hazardous for a >25lb box, contrary to an 'accessible, not dangerous' hide.

test_2_jcb_hard_constraints.summary: Fails the no-water-crossing / not-dangerous rule, which is the very thing that defines this spot. jcbOk = false.

survives_logic: survives = distinctFit AND jcbOk AND meaningful matchScore. distinctFit=false (all HITs are generic baseline filters), jcbOk=false (water crossing violates JCB safety rule). Both fail; verdict REJECTED.
verdict: Rejected. The 3 hits are generic access filters true of every park spot; defining creek-crossing violates JCB no-water-crossing rule and adds no distinct signature.
